Casey (CSE): Heads-up: prepping FY25 QBR for Solstice Health — main ask: cost/forecast section + token burn story. Can we get a 90-day burn + projected run-rate with current optimizations?
Priya (Solutions Eng): I can pull inference logs and effective tokens/week. Will need model variants and % cached hit rate. @Riley do you have latest contract commit numbers?
Riley (AE): Renewal target 06/30, 25% expansion. Committed capacity = 4 reserved GPU slots, committed spend $42k/mo.
Sam (Finance): Quick forecast: baseline run-rate w/o changes ~ $150k/quarter. If we enable prefix caching + 8-bit quant, est -30% -> ~$105k/quarter. I'll paste the export.
Sam (Finance): ```
redwood metrics query --account solstice --range 90d --group tokens,model,cache_hit
``` 
Sam (Finance): Export summary: 90d tokens=1,800,324,112; avg token cost=$0.00006; cache_hit=12%; top model=gpt-4o-mini (60% traffic)
Casey (CSE): Nice — can you paste the key lines from the export? need a single slide with bullets.
Sam (Finance): Summary lines for slide:
- 90d token burn: 1.8B tokens
- Baseline spend (90d): $150,000
- Projected w/ cache+8bit+dedupe: $98,000 (35% reduction)
- Risk scenario (cache miss + peak): $175,000
Priya (Solutions Eng): Also found prompt duplication causing prefix misses. Quick fix: dedupe system prompts at client side; estimated immediate 8% token reduction.
Jordan (CSM): Customer asks for budget alerts and predictable invoices. Can we set guardrails notifying at 60/80/95% of forecast? Also capture latency feedback post-quant.
Milo (Billing Bot): Budget alert created: solstice-guardrail-6080-95 -> webhook to #cs-alerts, email alerts to finance@solstice.health
Riley (AE): @Jordan I'll schedule a 30m stakeholder call next Tue to walk the QBR draft and savings plan.
Casey (CSE): For the slide: 3 bullets: current run-rate, recommended optimizations + est savings, and risk window (renewal impact if spend > forecast). I'll assemble; drop final numbers by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
Sam (Finance): Quick table snippet for the deck:
- Baseline: $150k/qtr
- Optimized (cache+8bit+dedupe): $98k/qtr
- Worst (peak+cache fail): $175k/qtr
Priya (Solutions Eng): I'll draft an ops checklist for enabling prefix caching + rollback commands. Will include commands and metrics to watch during canary.
Jordan (CSM): Customer quote to record: "Need predictable invoices — surprise token spikes are killer." I'll add to the feedback slide.
Casey (CSE): Copy. I'll draft the QBR slide and post the deck link when ready. Thanks everyone.
